summary: Aeva Technologies, Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a common stock offering targeting $100 million in gross proceeds, with an underwriter option for an additional $15 million. The offering price is to be determined; on June 2, 2026, the last sale price was $27.76 per share. Joint book-running managers are Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs & Co. LLC, and Oppenheimer & Co. The use of proceeds is not detailed beyond standard risk factors. This is a routine seasoned equity offering, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. No special-situation mechanics or arbitrage angle are present. The sole event is a capital raise via underwritten public offering.
